text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold Stock D and E when they were above my average cost, but a gain relative to my purchase price is not a reason by itself to sell; I should consider each holding’s outlook and its role in the whole portfolio.","My account value declined even after those sales, reminding me to judge progress by total portfolio performance rather than realized gains or whether each stock is above my cost basis.","I bought several stocks after a period of losses, but past price moves do not predict what comes next; I should avoid reactive trading and follow a deliberate plan based on current information and risk."]}
